segments.english:
Chapter 51
Suspension
Of the town of Nettuno.

segments.label: Suspension pending investigation
segments.original: Obligando la sicurezza, con che deue prouedersi alla salute publica, ad inuigilare con ogni più esquisita diligenza alla preseruatione della medesima, & essendo necessario in queste materie abondare nelle cautele; di quì è, che la Santità di N. S. in continuatione del suo Paterno zelo, e dell’applicatione sua vigilantissima verso la conseruatione de’ suoi sudditi, al primo auuiso hauutosi, che nella Terra di Netunno vi sia corso qualche male, benche non habbia apparenza di Contagio, & à quest’effetto si siano trasmessi Medici, e Periti per indagarne la verità, nondimeno hà risoluto à maggior cautela, che si sospenda alla Terra sudetta il commercio ad arbitrio di Sua Santità, con le pene contenute nel Bando publicato in materia simile, sotto li 20. di Maggio dell’anno corrente.
segments.english: The security with which public health must be provided for requires the most exact diligence in watching over its preservation, and in these matters abundant precautions are necessary. Therefore His Holiness Our Lord, continuing his paternal zeal and most vigilant attention to the preservation of his subjects, upon the first report that some illness has occurred at Nettuno, although it has no appearance of contagion and physicians and experts have been sent to investigate the truth, has nevertheless resolved, as a greater precaution, to suspend movement and dealings with that town at His Holiness’s discretion, under the penalties contained in the proclamation published on a similar matter on 20 May of the current year.

notes.text: The source expressly says that the reported illness has no appearance of contagion and that experts have been sent. The suspension is precautionary; the passage is not a confirmed plague diagnosis.
